change.summary: Replace the incorrect inclined retractable-stair concept with an operable rear rescue window beside a wall-mounted vertical foldout ladder that deploys outward by controlled gravity assist.

rescue_window.operation: side-hinged operable rescue opening; clear opening, hardware and inward/outward swing require product and fire review

egress_reserve.type: wall-mounted vertical foldout emergency escape ladder
egress_reserve.deployment_mode: manual top release with controlled gravity-assisted descent; fixed inner rail, moving outer rail and rungs rotating 90 degrees
egress_reserve.security_intent: release without key from the served opening; no operating handle accessible from grade
